Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.

Totally get wanting the best bang for your buck – roses are a real investment, not just a purchase.

Based on what we highlight as long-term, high-value choices, two great “value for money” options are:

Parfuma® Earth Angel
Amazing Grace (the rose, not the tulip)

Here’s how they compare so you can pick the better fit for you:

1) Parfuma® Earth Angel

Best for: Maximum “wow” factor per plant.
Look: Very full, peony-like blooms with an old-fashioned, romantic style.
Fragrance: Emphasized for its unforgettable scent; great if fragrance is a priority.
Value angle: A true perennial workhorse: one-time planting, comes back every year, and is chosen for both beauty and scent, so you get a lot of impact from a single bush.

2) Amazing Grace (rose)

Best for: Soft, elegant color and reliable performance.
Look: Soft, ruffled petals with a gentle blush pink tone; very classic and easy to pair with other plants.
Fragrance: Gentle, more about an overall graceful effect than a big perfume statement.
Value angle: Highlighted as a dependable garden performer that returns stronger each season, so you’re investing in something that improves over time instead of replanting.

Which is the better value for you?

Choose Parfuma® Earth Angel if you want the most “luxury per plant” with big fragrance and very showy blooms.
Choose Amazing Grace if you want a softer, romantic look that quietly ties the garden together and you care most about steady, reliable performance year after year.
